name: bb-plugin-restart-resume
description: bb plugin: continue threads that a bb restart interrupted, and show on every thread why its last turn stopped.

bb.name: Restart resume
bb.description: Continue threads interrupted because their machine's bb daemon restarted or lost its connection (at most 3 times in a row), and show why a thread's last turn stopped: by you or an agent, a daemon restart, a lost connection, with the auto-resume count.

scripts.lint: oxlint server.ts app.tsx core adapter tests
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && bb plugin build
